name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::rbegin, std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first character of the reversed string. It corresponds to the last character of the non-reversed string.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first character.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports crbegin() to C++98 mode.
